description: GitHub releases of a repository, newest first: tag, name, publish date, pre-release flag, link and the first 1,500 characters of the release notes, for the last 1-10 releases. Give owner/name or a github.com URL; public repositories only. Use to check the latest version of a tool, read what changed before upgrading a dependency or watch a project for new releases. Example: repo=cloudflare/workers-sdk. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
